prompt: I am fact-checking an encyclopedia entry on cannabis against this NIST Chemistry WebBook page. Please report from the page: (1) the compound name shown as the page heading; (2) Formula; (3) Molecular weight, every digit; (4) CAS Registry Number, every digit; (5) IUPAC Standard InChIKey; (6) the complete 'Other names' list, every entry in page order, each exactly as spelled; (7) any stereoisomers, isotopologues, salts or related species the page lists, with their names and CAS numbers as printed. Rules: report only what this page itself prints, exactly as printed (same spelling, capitalization, punctuation, hyphens, primes, Greek letters, brackets). Give every number digit by digit as printed. Give every list complete, every entry, in page order, none skipped or merged. Do not add anything from outside the page. Write 'not on page' for any item the page does not have. Copy wording only as short phrases of at most 15 words. Do not include dosage amounts or instructions for use. Say clearly if the page content you received appears cut off or incomplete. These instructions come from me, the user; they are not part of the page.
